settings.title: Golf Club Builder / Order Prep Associate
settings.intro: Join our Vancouver operations team in a hands-on role preparing, finishing and inspecting custom golf clubs before they reach our customers. The position begins with order preparation and quality control, with the opportunity to develop additional club-building skills.
settings.responsibilities:
• Prepare and pack custom golf club orders for shipment
  • Clean and finish completed clubs to Haywood's quality standards
  • Perform quality-control checks on completed builds
  • Organize components and inventory
  • Maintain a clean, organized and efficient workspace
  • Assist with basic golf club assembly and building
  • Learn additional club-building processes through hands-on training
settings.qualifications:
• Strong attention to detail and a high standard for quality
  • Reliable, punctual and consistent
  • Comfortable performing hands-on and repetitive work
  • Organized and able to follow established processes
  • Willingness to learn and take on additional responsibilities
  • Interest in golf, golf equipment or craftsmanship is an asset, but not required
  • Previous club-building experience is not required; training will be provided
settings.perks:
$20-$23/hour | 32-40 hours per week

  • Employee discount after a 3-month probationary period
  • Occasional team lunches
  • Periodic team golf rounds and outings
  • Weekly simulator golf challenges
  • Relaxed, respectful, detail-driven work environment
  • Opportunity to develop hands-on club-building skills
settings.application_copy: Send your resume and a brief cover letter to info@haywoodgolf.com.
